title: Podcast EP371: How Vinci is Revolutionizing Hardware Design with John Bruggeman
text:

Categories: EDA, Vinci

Daniel is joined by John Bruggeman, Chief Marketing Officer at Vinci, where he leads the company’s market narrative and strategic positioning. His work focuses on translating complex technical advances into clear category definition, industry relevance, and market adoption.
Daniel discusses How Vinci fits into the hardware design process with John. The backdrop for this conversation is Vinci’s recently announced $250M second-round investment at a $1.5B valuation. John describes in some detail how Vinci will fundamentally change the way physical hardware is designed. He cites three developments in the industry that opened the door for Vinci’s innovation. First is the maturation and widespread use of AI. The second is the rise of GPU-based computation. And the third is the development and maturation of new approaches to computational physics.
John explains that physics is fundamental to all hardware design, but until recently performing high fidelity, manufacturing-based analysis was too slow and cumbersome to be used throughout the design process. He describes how Vinci is changing that with technology that delivers highly accurate results in minutes for vast, complex systems. John explains this will allow high fidelity physics to be the intelligence layer that drives all hardware design innovation. He provides significant detail about Vinci’s market accomplishments, which now allow highly accurate physics-based analysis to inform the best design decisions throughout the process.
